htmlCases.semantics: nth-last-child counts every element sibling from the end, not only matching p elements
the first p is the third element child from the end
the second element child from the end is a div, so the p selector has no result

syntheticDocumentCases.semantics: top-level fragment elements are children of Jsoup Document only through a synthetic boundary and must fail closed

affectedSourceSet.binding: The frozen 458-source package contains no nth-last-child rule; this fixture protects the general Legado selector contract without assigning a source failure.

legadoSemantics.implementation: AnalyzeByJSoup delegates CSS selection to Jsoup Element.select.
legadoSemantics.position: nth-last-child is one-based from the end and counts all element siblings.
legadoSemantics.documentBoundary: A top-level fragment element whose parent is the Jsoup Document does not satisfy child pseudos.

consumerContract.arkWeb: The synthetic Document path manually evaluates standard pseudos after browser selection.
